content.rendered:
CARRIED BY KINGS

“Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;” (Nehemiah 2: 7)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

Whilst requesting a letter to be written by the king to the governors of provinces, Nehemiah requested that the governors be mandated to convey him until he comes into Judah. Nehemiah did not just request for a letter that would mandate the governors to allow him to pass by; he requested for a letter that would make his movement a responsibility of the governors; he requested for a letter that would cause the governors to carry him.

Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: you will get a royal treatment. Kings will convey you to your next level. Kings will carry you to your destination. Kings will open the doors you need to walk through; kings will take you to the place you have been desiring to be in; kings will make your movement in life easier and faster; kings will be your transporters in destiny; kings will move you higher; kings will make efforts on your behalf and for your benefit.

Nehemiah demanded that the letters to be written to governors should mandate them to get him to Judah. So the governors were to keep moving him until he gets to his destination; they were to keep working for Nehemiah until he gets to his destination. Hear me as I hear the Lord: the kings that God is sending to you will not stop until you get to your destination. They will make efforts until you have all you need.

Get set: your time to be served by kings has come. They will serve you until you get your desired results. They will serve you until they make a way for you. They will serve you until they make life easier for you. They will serve you until you hit your goals and targets. They will serve you until your dreams become a reality. They will serve you until you get all you are supposed to get. They will serve you and will not stop on the way.

You have been remembered for royal treatment. You will be carried by kings. Kings will convey you to your destination.

Isaiah 60: 10 says: “And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.”

Declare With Me: Kings will carry me to my destination, in Jesus’ name!
